shared_elements: eye-like circular motif within a head
sets of short parallel incised lines
justification: Both surfaces carry curvilinear outline creatures with hooked, beak-like heads and circular eye motifs, plus small bundles of parallel strokes, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a few large, isolated, boldly rounded figures dominating a boulder with much blank rock between them, whereas B is a dense, near-symmetrical, all-over composition of fine interlocking scrolls, fan/plume shapes and small filler signs with no empty ground — different compositional logic and different rendering conventions.
